Customisation

☁️ Cloud Playlist Sync – Your
 playlists are safely stored in the cloud. Log in anytime and get your music back, even after data loss.

🔐 Google Sign-In (Firebase) – Secure and fast login with reliable cloud backup.

🎧 Synced Downloads – Downloads stay linked to your account, offline songs remain playable after re-login.

📶 Offline Playback – Enjoy your music without internet.

⚡ More Stable Streaming – Smoother playback and better performance.

💯Added 3 theme style and player layout.

Update now & keep your music safe forever
